prompts.prompt: Slow gimbal tracking shot moving past server racks toward Elena, who is typing rhythmically at her desk.
A tight, handheld follow shot of Elena's eyes scanning lines of code, focusing on a single blinking red character.
Rapid, rhythmic cuts between Elena's face and flickering screens, getting progressively faster to show mounting panic.
A very slow, deliberate zoom into Elena's face as the 'IDENTITY NOT FOUND' text appears on her screen.
A handheld, slightly shaky shot moving around Elena's apartment to show the chaotic, makeshift command center.
Quick cuts between complex, geometric network diagrams and Elena's tightening jaw.
A slow, unsettling pan around the room, catching glimpses of shadows that seem to move.
A wide shot slowly zooming into a monitor displaying a complex network topology, with dawn light creeping in.
A slow pull-back from a monitor showing a dead woman's photo to reveal Elena's face in the dark bezel.
A slow, creeping push-in on Elena's eyes as they reflect the distorted images on her screen.
A slow pull-back from a tight shot of Elena to reveal the vast, empty conference room around her.
A slow, oppressive push toward Elena as she sits motionless amidst the flickering screens.
A wide, sweeping drone shot over the vast, cold, and desolate interior of the subterranean server farm.
A slow pan across a room filled with screens, ending on Elena sitting in total darkness.
A slow, clinical push-in on Elena, who stares blankly at a wall of code.
A static, black screen that slowly fades out to nothing.
